item.title: Hopeless Rumantic
item.description: My horse plods slowly through the endless expanse of night. I take occasional sips from my flask, a drifter in a sea of souls. Each splash of rum stings at my ever-parched throat, but ignites the world in flames of regret—the lamentations of those who have gone before me. A tired old man, grieving that his estranged son never knew that he loved him. A child who lived and died alone on the streets, uncared for.
